considered_not_added: BI 730357 human whole-blood ex vivo IL-17 assay (Harcken 2021, IC50 ~140 nM): the same system as the draft's human-whole-blood-il17-vtp track (human whole-blood IL-17 secretion ex vivo); a BI-side entry would not change that track's status, and the Harcken full text could not be fetched to quote it.

IL-23 minicircle mouse (BI 730357) for engagement: already tracked (il23-minicircle-mouse-bi, efficacy cell). Lead for the main draft, not a new system: Delic 2026 JID (doi:10.1016/j.jid.2025.06.1588, PMID 40683336) reports lesional-skin IL-23/IL-17 gene inhibition >1.5-fold at 100-200 mg but shallower than anti-IL-17 antibodies, the patient side of the mouse's skin IL-17A mRNA readout (up to 109% inhibition). Research letter, paywalled; read via search snippet only.

Ooi 2023 bounded-integer PK/PD model of PASI (in silico): fitted to the same Phase I/II patient data whose plateau it describes; not a model run before or independently of the patient result, so not a model-system prediction (not even a retrodiction with independent inputs).

Human RORC bi-allelic loss of function (Okada 2015 Science, human_genetic; predicts candidiasis and mycobacterial susceptibility): no source compares it with infections in any member's trial; Gooderham 2025 abstract reports only that BI 730357 was well tolerated. No comparison, so no track.

RORgt-null / adult-deleted mouse thymic lymphoma and thymocyte-apoptosis in vitro margin (PMC11737796, AZ compounds; Guntermann 2017 JCI Insight, Novartis compound): no member drug tested and no trial long enough to compare; the draft's safety judgement already names the concern.
JNJ-54271074 human psoriatic epidermal cell + skin-homing T cell co-culture and IL-23 mouse (Xue 2016 Sci Rep): compound is not a class member, and no member was run in it with a patient comparison.
VTP-43742 nonclinical models (patent-only, Expert Opin Ther Pat 2016/2017) and AGN-242428 nonclinical package (protocol defers to the IB): no published model data, nothing to compare.

GSK2981278 post-hoc skin penetration work: none found beyond the sRICA explants and IMQ mouse the draft already tracks; Sci Rep 2021 (PMC8080595) notes skin exposure was never disclosed but runs a different compound.
